This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Infrastructure Engineer L2 (CUCM) based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong expertise in Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) to join an international Managed Services team. In this role, you will provide advanced technical support, troubleshoot complex infrastructure environments, and ensure the stability and reliability of enterprise IT services. You will work across unified communications, virtualization, and virtual desktop infrastructure, supporting multiple technology platforms and customer environments. Working within an established service delivery framework, you will manage technical requests, resolve incidents, and contribute to infrastructure improvements while meeting defined service-level objectives. You will collaborate with a global Network Operations Center and international technical teams to deliver reliable, high-quality support. This fully remote opportunity offers long-term engagement with a US-based client and requires excellent English communication skills.

lists.content:
• Provide Level 2 infrastructure support within a Managed Services environment, handling technical incidents and service requests through an established ticketing system.
  • Support and maintain Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice and unified communications infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot, administer, and maintain VMware vCenter and vSphere environments, including ESXi hosts, vMotion, High Availability (HA), Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS), distributed virtual switches, and virtual machine lifecycle management.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS environments, including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and Virtual Delivery Agents (VDAs).
  • Investigate and resolve complex infrastructure issues involving multiple interconnected systems, ensuring minimal service disruption.
  • Design, implement, and support infrastructure solutions that meet customer requirements and operational standards.
  • Manage technical tickets, prioritize incidents, and deliver resolutions in accordance with established Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Collaborate with the global Network Operations Center (NOC), which handles first-line monitoring and incident intake, to ensure effective escalation and resolution.
  • Use remote support tools to diagnose technical problems, perform maintenance activities, and support end users across different environments.
  • Maintain clear and accurate technical documentation, including troubleshooting procedures, incident reports, and resolution records.
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions effectively to end users and internal stakeholders, ensuring a professional and customer-focused support experience.
  • Coordinate with multiple customer environments and technical teams, managing competing priorities while maintaining service quality.
  • Contribute to continuous service improvement by identifying recurring issues, recommending solutions, and following established IT service management practices.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 8 years of professional experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or enterprise technical support.
  • Mandatory fluent English proficiency, both written and spoken, to collaborate effectively with international teams and support a US-based client.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice or unified communications infrastructure.
  • Extensive practical knowledge of VMware vCenter and vSphere, including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and virtual machine lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS, including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across multiple systems and technology platforms.
  • Experience designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise infrastructure solutions.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, remote support tools, incident management, and service delivery against defined Service Level Objectives.
  • Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and patiently to end users.
  • Excellent written documentation skills, including the ability to maintain accurate technical records and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize incidents, and manage multiple customer environments simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges.
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical professional experience.
  • Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or in a multi-client support environment is highly desirable.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience working in an MSP environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery frameworks and operational best practices.
  • Previous experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Knowledge of enterprise storage platforms and related infrastructure technologies.
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Active Directory and Okta.
  • Knowledge of enterprise firewall technologies, particularly Palo Alto and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD).
  • Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
  • Strong ability to collaborate with geographically distributed technical teams and support international customers.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Long-term engagement with an initial duration of 12+ months.
  • Full-time opportunity through a staff augmentation model.
  • Opportunity to work with a US-based client in an international IT services environment.
  • Exposure to enterprise-grade infrastructure and technologies, including Cisco CUCM, VMware, and Citrix.
  • Opportunity to strengthen technical expertise across unified communications, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Collaboration with a global Network Operations Center and experienced international technical teams.
  • Professional experience within a structured Managed Services environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to complex infrastructure support and implementation projects.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Inside Sales / Closer Pleno based in Brazil.

We are looking for a mid-level Inside Sales professional with a strong closing mindset and a consultative approach to customer relationships. In this fully remote role, you will guide prospective patients from their first expression of interest through consultation scheduling and treatment decisions. You will be responsible for qualifying leads, building trust, managing follow-ups, and converting opportunities into confirmed appointments and sales. Working in a specialized healthcare environment, you will combine commercial discipline with empathy and attentive communication. You will also monitor pipeline performance and conversion metrics to continuously improve results. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the patient experience while contributing to commercial growth.

lists.content:
• Respond to incoming leads and execute structured outbound contact sequences through phone calls and WhatsApp.

  • Understand and qualify prospective patients’ needs, guiding them through the consultation scheduling and confirmation process with specialists.

  • Build rapport and establish trust through consultative conversations, active listening, and clear communication.

  • Manage follow-up routines and implement recovery strategies for patients who miss scheduled appointments.

  • Maintain contact with patients after their consultations, answering questions, addressing concerns, handling objections, and guiding them through the decision-making and closing process.

  • Conduct sales negotiations and drive opportunities toward successful conversion.

  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, ensuring consistent pipeline management.

  • Monitor daily sales indicators, funnel performance, and conversion rates.

  • Participate in daily alignment meetings and weekly sessions focused on performance analysis and commercial strategy.

    • Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Closer or in a sales role focused on closing deals.

  • Strong knowledge of consultative selling techniques, rapport building, active listening, and structured objection handling.

  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN Selling.

  • Proven experience conducting sales conversations and negotiations by phone and WhatsApp.

  • Experience qualifying leads, scheduling consultations, and recovering no-show opportunities.

  • Practical experience using CRM platforms and managing sales pipelines.

  • Completed high school education.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate persuasively and empathetically.

  • Resilience when handling rejection, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage priorities independently.

  • Self-discipline and accountability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

    • Nice to have:

  • A degree in progress or completed in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales Management, or a related field.

  • Experience selling healthcare, aesthetics, or high-ticket products and services.

  • Additional training or certifications in negotiation, closing techniques, or healthcare-focused customer service.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Full-time professional opportunity.

  • Contractor engagement model (Pessoa Jurídica – PJ).

  • Opportunity to work in a specialized healthcare environment.

  • Direct involvement in the patient journey, combining consultative sales with a strong focus on customer experience.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced Integrated Marketing Manager to lead demand generation and pipeline growth for a portfolio of cloud-based productivity and AI solutions. In this role, you will develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that attract qualified prospects, strengthen customer engagement, and generate measurable business opportunities. Working closely with sales, creative, content, and go-to-market teams, you will coordinate multi-channel initiatives and maximize the impact of marketing assets. You will also drive event promotion, develop compelling customer success stories, and ensure marketing investments deliver measurable returns. Combining strategic thinking, digital marketing expertise, and strong project management skills, you will play a key role in connecting marketing activities with commercial outcomes. This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, international technology environment while developing your expertise in cloud and AI solutions.

lists.content:
Own the planning and execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to generate qualified leads, accelerate pipeline development, and support revenue growth. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful campaigns, optimize marketing resources, and demonstrate the commercial value of marketing investments.

  • Design and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, social media, targeted advertising lists, and other digital channels to attract qualified prospects and generate measurable pipeline.

  • Develop and implement campaign strategies promoting cloud productivity and AI solutions, ensuring alignment with broader go-to-market objectives.

  • Collaborate with internal creative, copywriting, and content teams to develop and deploy compelling marketing assets that communicate product value and support campaign performance.

  • Leverage existing content and marketing resources, adapting and localizing materials to meet campaign requirements and create effective sales enablement collateral.

  • Partner with go-to-market teams to plan and execute promotional strategies for joint events and webinars, maximizing attendance and engagement among high-value prospects.

  • Work with sales teams, customers, and internal content specialists to identify successful customer stories and develop compelling case studies that demonstrate the value of integrated technology solutions.

  • Manage marketing development funds (MDF) compliance by preparing proof-of-performance reports, documenting campaign activities, and maintaining supporting materials required for funding validation.

  • Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and return on investment to assess effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities.

  • Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of marketing assets, campaign materials, and related activities.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, strengthen collaboration, and increase marketing impact.

    • Requirements:

    We are looking for a results-oriented marketing professional with a strong background in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, and integrated campaign management. The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, content marketing expertise, and excellent project management skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and translate marketing initiatives into measurable commercial results.

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, or campaign management.

  • Demonstrated ability to use content marketing and digital assets to improve lead conversion and contribute to pipeline growth.

  • Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies and demand generation best practices.

  • Data-driven mindset, with a strong focus on tracking campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, asset creation processes, content deliveries, and marketing lists simultaneously.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with sales, creative, content, and go-to-market teams.

  • Ability to develop compelling marketing messages and leverage customer success stories to communicate business value.

  • Experience managing marketing budgets, campaign documentation, and performance reporting is an advantage.

  • Previous experience within a cloud technology partner ecosystem, particularly Google Cloud, Microsoft, or AWS, is preferred.

  • Familiarity with marketing and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Google Workspace, Cvent, and Asana is considered a plus.

  • Proactive, adaptable, and commercially minded approach, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual compensation ranging from $90,000 to $110,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Additional 10% annual bonus opportunity.

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Flexibility to work from another location, including internationally, for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career advancement.

  • Supportive and collaborative international working environment.

  • Inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, individual contributions, and different professional experiences.

  • Opportunities to contribute to local communities and participate in initiatives that create a positive social impact.

  • Culture built around three core values: Hunger, Heart, and Harmony.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Specialist - Data & Analytics Delivery based in Brazil.

We are looking for an experienced IT and Data & Analytics professional to lead the delivery of enterprise data solutions across a complex, international business environment. In this role, you will oversee strategic initiatives involving Databricks, SAP, Azure, and Microsoft BI technologies, ensuring alignment between business priorities and technical execution. You will take ownership of key data products throughout their lifecycle, from development and transformation to continuous improvement. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners, you will drive projects from initial discovery through successful implementation. You will also contribute to resource planning, budget management, and agile delivery while helping strengthen the local Data & Analytics team. This is an excellent opportunity to combine technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership in a collaborative and innovation-driven environment.

lists.content:
• Lead the design, development, and delivery of Data & Analytics solutions across Databricks, SAP, Azure, and Microsoft BI technologies.

  • Drive data migration, rollout, and transformation initiatives involving SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP BTP.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of selected data products, overseeing their development, enhancement, maintenance, and long-term performance.

  • Manage business demand intake, collaborate with stakeholders, and translate business needs into clear priorities and actionable delivery plans.

  • Lead resource allocation, financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting to ensure efficient execution and cost control.

  • Coordinate external partners and service providers, monitoring resource management, financial performance, and delivery quality.

  • Oversee large-scale initiatives from discovery and planning through implementation and go-live, ensuring clear project structures and effective execution.

  • Develop prototypes and remain involved in hands-on technical activities when required.

  • Organize tasks, dependencies, and agile delivery processes across multiple teams to maintain alignment and project momentum.

  • Support the development of the local Data & Analytics team, sharing expertise, fostering collaboration, and potentially taking on people management responsibilities.

    • Requirements:

  • Several years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Architecture, or technical and functional leadership roles.

  • Strong experience working with enterprise SAP environments, particularly SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP BTP.

  • Hands-on technical knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, SQL, and modern cloud-based data platforms.

  • Proven experience delivering data migration, integration, rollout, and transformation projects.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise data solutions, architecture, and the relationship between business requirements and technical delivery.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholders, and overseeing external technology partners.

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage priorities, resources, budgets, and multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a pragmatic, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent English proficiency, both written and spoken, is essential.

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience working in industrial or manufacturing environments.

  • Availability to start immediately.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with market standards and industry practices.

  • Healthcare coverage.

  • Annual performance bonus.

  • Meal allowance.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leave.

  • Emotional and mental well-being support programs.

  • Wellhub membership, providing access to fitness and wellness services.

  • Additional benefits designed to support work-life balance and employee well-being.

  • Flexible working model.

  • Permanent, full-time employment.

  • Working hours from Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:15 PM.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions to promote consistent engineering standards and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, investigate root causes, and implement sustainable solutions to improve application stability and performance.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering methodologies, development workflows, and software delivery processes.
  • Apply secure software development practices, ensuring responsible use of AI tools and appropriate handling of sensitive information.
  • Participate in technical interview initiatives by evaluating candidates for assigned and other project teams, helping identify qualified professionals and support team growth.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, primarily focused on Java development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with practical experience developing and maintaining backend applications.
  • Solid experience working with relational databases, SQL queries, and data modeling.
  • Good understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed system fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing practices, including unit testing and integration testing.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and modern software development and delivery practices.
  • Practical experience using AI-powered development tools to support software engineering activities and improve development efficiency.
  • Ability to critically evaluate, test, validate, and refine AI-generated code, ensuring technical correctness and production readiness.
  • Understanding of secure software development principles, including responsible AI usage and the protection of confidential or sensitive information.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on delivering high-quality technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated sense of technical ownership and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with international stakeholders and participate in technical discussions.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1–C2 preferred), as the role involves working directly with US-based clients and requires effective communication in meetings and professional interactions.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary paid in USD.
  • Fully remote working arrangement across Latin America.
  • Access to coworking spaces throughout the region for those who prefer occasional in-person collaboration.
  • Paid time off in accordance with the employment regulations of your country, with full salary.
  • Paid national public holidays.
  • Sick leave provisions.
  • Annual refundable allowance to support health and personal well-being expenses.
  • Additional day off to celebrate your birthday.
  • Dedicated People Care team providing support with well-being, time off, and employee needs.
  • Autonomous working environment with genuine ownership and minimal micromanagement.
  • Opportunities to work with international clients and experienced engineering professionals.
  • Exposure to AI-first software development practices, modern technologies, and agentic workflows.
  • Opportunities for technical development, knowledge sharing, and participation in architectural initiatives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer, Data Governance & Platform based in Brazil.

As the technical owner of data governance, you will build the systems and standards that make company-wide data reliable, consistent, and actionable. Working closely with the Data Director and a senior analytics team, you will strengthen data quality across the entire stack, from source events and pipelines to dashboards and machine learning models. You will develop automated monitoring, expand governed metric definitions, improve data lineage, and maintain trusted analytics infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building scalable solutions rather than managing manual checks or producing dashboards. You will also help shape the data platform roadmap, influence governance standards, and progressively expand the function as business needs evolve.

lists.content:
You will establish and operate the data governance function, turning its priorities into practical systems, automated controls, and reliable processes. As the technical reference for analytics engineering, you will work across teams to prevent data issues, improve platform consistency, and ensure stakeholders can trust the information they use.

  • Build and scale automated data quality and freshness monitoring, including freshness checks, schema-change alerts, and anomaly detection, to identify upstream issues before they affect downstream systems.

  • Investigate data incidents, coordinate resolution, and continuously improve monitoring coverage to reduce reliance on manual troubleshooting.

  • Expand semantic-layer coverage by defining and mapping additional business metrics, ensuring every metric has one consistent, governed definition.

  • Maintain semantic-layer quality as it grows, including naming conventions, documentation, and definition consistency.

  • Review new Segment events against established governance standards and maintain an event catalog that accurately reflects production tracking.

  • Investigate event-tracking inconsistencies, identify implementation drift, and ensure changes remain compliant with agreed standards.

  • Extend data lineage capabilities beyond dbt by connecting Segment events and Lightdash, enabling teams to understand downstream impacts before production changes are released.

  • Maintain Lightdash workspace quality through certification, naming standards, permissions management, and improvements to the discoverability and reliability of self-service analytics.

  • Partner with the Data Director to translate the needs of product, marketing, operations, and finance into a prioritized data platform roadmap.

  • Balance stakeholder requests with platform reliability and long-term governance priorities, communicating trade-offs and setting clear expectations.

  • Serve as a technical mentor and trusted point of contact for analysts and other colleagues, helping raise engineering standards across the team.

  • As the function expands, take on broader ownership of its roadmap and contribute to hiring and developing additional team members.

    • Requirements:

    You are a hands-on analytics engineering professional who sees data governance as a core technical discipline. You combine strong SQL and data pipeline expertise with an automation-first mindset, using AI tools to improve engineering workflows and build more reliable systems. You are comfortable influencing technical standards through expertise, clear communication, and collaboration rather than relying on formal authority.

  • Strong practical experience with analytics engineering, particularly data warehouses, data pipelines, and data transformation workflows.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and experience debugging, maintaining, and improving data infrastructure.

  • Experience with tools such as Redshift, dbt, and Airflow, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with data ingestion and event-tracking platforms such as Fivetran and Segment.

  • Understanding of data governance principles, including data quality, freshness monitoring, schema management, metric definitions, event tracking standards, and lineage.

  • Experience building automated checks, monitoring systems, and alerts that identify data issues proactively rather than relying on manual reviews.

  • Ability to work across the data lifecycle, from source systems and ingestion to transformation, semantic layers, BI platforms, and downstream data products.

  • Familiarity with BI and semantic-layer tools such as Lightdash, Tableau, or Metabase is an advantage.

  • An automation-first approach, with the ability to identify repetitive quality checks and turn them into scalable technical solutions.

  • Daily practical use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar tools to build automation, investigate anomalies, write code, and document workflows.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex data issues independently.

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, guide colleagues, and establish standards across teams.

  • A collaborative and proactive approach, with the confidence to challenge requests, explain priorities, and balance immediate business needs against long-term platform health.

  • Willingness to remain hands-on as the role evolves, while being open to developing people-management responsibilities if the governance function grows.

    • Benefits:

  • Base salary: USD $75,000–$100,000 per year.

  • Contractor arrangement: Compensation structure aligned with the company's Latin America-based team.

  • Fully remote: Work remotely with the flexibility to manage your own working environment.

  • Flexible paid time off: Take time off as needed, with an emphasis on results and accountability.

  • Asynchronous collaboration: A work environment that supports focused, independent work and flexible coordination across teams.

  • Equity: This position does not include equity compensation.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Data Analyst, Growth & Experimentation based in Brazil.

Join a data-driven team at a growing digital marketplace, where experimentation and analytical rigor play a central role in business growth. As the first analyst fully dedicated to Growth and Experimentation, you will lead the analytical strategy behind testing initiatives across acquisition and conversion channels. You will design robust experiments, establish statistical standards, and turn complex findings into actionable recommendations that improve business performance. Working closely with Growth leadership, product managers, and marketing teams, you will help optimize the full acquisition-to-conversion funnel across paid, organic, and partner channels. You will also expand existing analytics automation and AI-powered tools to make experimentation more scalable and accessible. This is a highly autonomous individual-contributor role with meaningful influence on strategic decisions and measurable growth outcomes.

lists.content:
• Lead the experimentation program across web funnels, SMS and email campaigns, sales-led initiatives, and SEO experiments.

  • Define experiment design standards, including statistical power, sample sizes, significance thresholds, and analysis plans.

  • Identify underpowered tests, false positives, tracking issues, and attribution problems before they lead to inaccurate business decisions.

  • Apply anytime-valid statistical monitoring to support reliable decisions during ongoing experiments.

  • Develop and improve self-service experimentation capabilities, including automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-based statistical significance tools, and AI-powered workflows.

  • Maintain and extend existing AI routines supporting pre-test power calculations and live-test health monitoring.

  • Build and maintain a trusted acquisition-to-conversion funnel covering visitors, leads, and customers across brands and channels.

  • Analyze customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), conversion rates, attribution, and channel performance to support investment decisions.

  • Collaborate with the Director of CRO, performance marketing teams, and Growth product managers to translate analytical findings into business recommendations.

  • Influence prioritization and strategic decisions through clear, evidence-based insights while leaving final testing priorities and direction to Growth leadership.

  • Establish scalable analytics standards, documentation, and a Growth experimentation playbook.

  • Evaluate the experimentation technology stack and provide recommendations on whether to adopt external statistical tools or further develop existing internal capabilities.

    • Requirements:

  • Strong professional experience in data analytics, product analytics, growth analytics, or experimentation, ideally in a marketplace or digital business environment.

  • Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently build and maintain analytical models.

  • Practical Python experience, particularly for statistical calculations, automation, and analytical tooling.

  • Experience with dbt and Lightdash or comparable data transformation and business intelligence platforms.

  • Strong statistical knowledge, including experimental design, power and sample-size calculations, significance testing, novelty effects, and interaction effects.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, evaluating, and interpreting A/B tests and other experimentation methods.

  • Understanding of experiment instrumentation, including event tracking, randomization, and tools such as Segment and Flagsmith.

  • Experience building and analyzing acquisition-to-conversion funnels, with a strong understanding of CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and channel economics.

  • Familiarity with attribution challenges, seasonality, and channel mix in growth and performance marketing environments.

  • Ability to identify tracking and data-quality issues and ensure experiments produce reliable, actionable results.

  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar solutions to accelerate SQL development, dbt workflows, statistical analysis, and experimentation processes.

  • Ability to work independently, extend existing automation, and develop scalable self-service analytical solutions.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product and marketing decisions without direct authority.

  • Business-oriented mindset, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear recommendations.

  • Comfortable challenging assumptions, communicating uncertainty, and prioritizing analytical rigor while maintaining a bias for action.

  • Able to operate as a senior individual contributor without direct people-management responsibilities.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual base salary of $75,000–$100,000 USD.

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with flexibility to manage your work environment and coordinate overlapping hours with US-based teams.

  • Flexible paid time off, with an emphasis on results rather than hours worked.

  • Access to established AI-powered experimentation tools and workflows, with the opportunity to expand their capabilities.

  • Significant ownership and visibility as the first analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation.

  • Opportunity to shape experimentation standards, analytical processes, and growth decision-making across the business.

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven marketing professional to develop and lead initiatives that generate qualified B2B leads and accelerate business growth. In this fully remote role, you will take ownership of the entire lead-generation funnel, from audience research and acquisition strategies to lead qualification and sales opportunities. You will design and execute multi-channel campaigns, identify new growth opportunities, and continuously improve conversion performance. lists.content:

  • Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies to attract qualified prospects, increase conversions, and support business growth.

  • Manage and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture to MQLs, SQLs, and sales opportunities.

  • Take ownership of marketing initiatives from market research and strategy development through campaign planning, execution, testing, analysis, and optimization.

  • Lead organic-first, multi-channel marketing programmes, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives.

  • Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data.

  • Monitor and report on funnel performance, including website traffic, landing-page engagement, lead nurturing, qualification, and conversion.

  • Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve campaign effectiveness and lead-generation results.

  • Improve website performance, organic visibility, user experience, and conversion rates through hands-on optimization and collaboration with relevant specialists.

  • Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development.

  • Work closely with the sales team to gather feedback on lead quality, customer needs, and market trends, translating insights into more effective targeting and messaging.

  • Use performance data and experimentation to continuously refine acquisition strategies and maximize pipeline contribution.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools to improve research, content development, marketing analysis, and campaign workflows.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strategic marketing expertise with hands-on execution and strong analytical capabilities. You should have experience generating qualified B2B leads in technology-driven markets, understand complex sales journeys, and be comfortable managing campaigns independently while coordinating cross-functional teams.

  • At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, with a proven track record of generating qualified leads and improving marketing performance.

  • Experience in B2B software development, IT services, SaaS, or the broader technology sector, ideally involving complex buying journeys and longer sales cycles.

  • At least 2 years of experience owning marketing campaigns or cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution and performance measurement.

  • Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing, including content, email, social media, PPC, and conversion rate optimization.

  • Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AEO, including keyword research, search intent, and organic visibility strategies.

  • Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or equivalent platforms.

  • Ability to connect marketing performance metrics with lead quality, sales pipeline, and revenue outcomes.

  • Strong AI proficiency, including practical experience using AI tools for research, content creation, analysis, and campaign optimization.

  • Solid understanding of audience targeting, positioning, and messaging, with the ability to develop compelling value propositions for different customer segments.

  • Proactive, ownership-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize initiatives based on potential impact and move projects forward independently.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate specialists, provide clear feedback, and manage cross-functional collaboration.

  • Fluent English proficiency (C1 level or higher).

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems.

  • Knowledge of email nurturing sequences and lead qualification processes.

  • Advanced expertise in conversion rate optimization, landing-page testing, and user behavior analysis.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work, with the flexibility to work from anywhere with a stable internet connection.

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to choose your preferred schedule and time zone.

  • Negotiable starting hourly rate based on skills and professional experience.

  • Monthly payments for contractors via wire transfer.

  • Paid training and ongoing professional development opportunities.

  • Access to modern technologies and opportunities to work on innovative projects.

  • Consistent workload with a steady flow of engaging and challenging assignments.

  • Annual pay increases based on performance.

  • International and collaborative remote working environment.

  • Equal-opportunity workplace that values diversity and inclusion.

  • Ensure commission procedures and agreements are properly implemented and aligned with business strategies, with required approvals documented through internal systems.

  • Monitor commission payments and outstanding balances, ensuring payments follow established legal and compliance requirements and that no commissions remain overdue.

  • Investigate and coordinate the resolution of commission complaints, potential compliance concerns, and other issues raised by channel partners.

  • Provide day-to-day assistance to global channel partners on commission-related matters and Incentive Commission System (ICS) questions.

  • Manage commission activities that require manual processing, including reporting, monthly coordination with relevant manufacturing teams, and payment tracking.

  • Support commission invoicing and royalty-related processes where applicable.

  • Contribute to the harmonization of commission claim systems and processes across regions.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, streamline, and automate recurring transactional activities, including ICS ticket management.

  • Apply commercial expertise and knowledge of internal policies to support sound decisions, collaborate across teams, and provide informal guidance to colleagues when needed.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

  • Advanced professional experience in sales and channel sales, ideally in an international business environment.

  • Advanced level of English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Analytical thinking and demonstrated ability to investigate, assess, and resolve complex issues.

  • Customer-oriented approach combined with a strong commitment to compliance, governance, and process discipline.

  • Ability to understand business drivers and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across different regions.

  • Established project management skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Confidence using IT tools and business systems to manage transactional and reporting activities.

  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and provide practical support to colleagues and external partners.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Salesforce.

  • Experience with SAP/Altais and ICS/Speak systems.

  • Experience supporting commission management, channel partner operations, ERP integrations, or related business processes.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote position based in Brazil.

  • No relocation assistance is provided.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Liquidity Operations Engineer based in Brazil.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Liquidity Operations Engineer to help manage and optimize liquidity across a rapidly evolving cross-chain payments ecosystem. In this high-ownership role, you will oversee liquidity positions across multiple digital assets, blockchain networks, wallets, exchanges, and bridges, ensuring capital efficiency, competitive execution, and controlled operational risk. You will monitor live balances, execute approved rebalances, investigate incidents, and ensure that operational activities are accurately reconciled. Working at the intersection of financial operations, blockchain infrastructure, and engineering, you will develop monitoring systems, dashboards, alerts, and automation to improve operational reliability. You will collaborate closely with quantitative specialists, engineers, and external providers to identify risks and continuously improve liquidity management processes. This is an exciting opportunity to help establish a new operational function within an innovative, remote-first organization shaping the future of cross-chain payments.

lists.content:
• Take ownership of day-to-day liquidity operations, monitoring and reconciling current and target balances across supported digital assets, blockchain networks, wallets, centralized exchanges (CEXs), bridges, and ongoing rebalances.
  • Execute and verify approved liquidity rebalances, transfers, configuration changes, provider disablements, and other time-sensitive operational actions.
  • Reconcile actual versus expected operational outcomes across balances, transfers, rebalances, transaction fees, profit and loss (P&L), and system states, identifying discrepancies and ensuring timely resolution.
  • Schedule recurring liquidity activities and participate in follow-the-sun on-call rotations, maintaining clear operational handovers, action logs, and accountability across coverage periods.
  • Apply established allocation strategies, risk limits, validation procedures, approval requirements, and escalation protocols to all material liquidity-related activities.
  • Investigate operational incidents, including balance discrepancies, stuck funds, outdated configurations, pricing anomalies, exchange failures, and unexpected liquidity shortages.
  • Respond to market-risk events such as volatility spikes, stablecoin depegs, price dislocations, provider disruptions, and unusual transaction flows by assessing exposure and implementing or escalating approved responses.
  • Coordinate with external bridge providers, cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain networks, and integration partners to resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Monitor external developments, including provider announcements, technical documentation, fee changes, asset updates, network deprecations, and service shutdowns, using data feeds and automated monitoring agents.
  • Translate incidents and external changes into actionable operational improvements, configuration updates, risk assessments, and clearly defined engineering tickets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards using Grafana and Datadog to monitor liquidity balances, ongoing transactions, execution performance, operational costs, and significant exceptions.
  • Design and implement actionable alerts and Slack notifications that enable early issue detection and provide clear guidance on required operational responses.
  • Develop safe automation for recurring checks and operational workflows, incorporating validation mechanisms, dry-run functionality, approval gates, audit trails, and rollback procedures.
  • Create, maintain, and improve operational documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, permission guides, checklists, incident playbooks, and decision trees.
  • Analyze transaction flows, execution outcomes, failure patterns, and historical rebalancing activity to improve liquidity targets, alert thresholds, and operational policies.
  • Collaborate with quantitative specialists to evaluate routing performance, rebalancing costs and timing, price impact, and the operational implications of allocation, pricing, and hedging decisions.
  • Work with engineering teams to transform recurring manual interventions and operational failures into reliable product and platform improvements.
  • Support the onboarding of new digital assets, blockchain networks, liquidity providers, and client requirements by establishing appropriate monitoring, controls, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure liquidity remains available where required, supporting reliable customer transactions, competitive execution, capital efficiency, and effective risk management.

    • Requirements:

  • Between 1 and 3+ years of practical experience in liquidity operations, trading operations, treasury management, market operations, cryptocurrency operations, or a comparable financial or technical environment.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets and operational risk management, including liquidity, order books, trade execution, transaction fees, slippage, financial exposure, and operational controls.
  • Experience performing or supporting time-sensitive financial or operational activities, with strong attention to detail and the ability to independently verify execution results.
  • Ability to query and analyze operational data, interpret system logs, work with APIs, and build or modify dashboards, monitoring alerts, and basic automation tools.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, or improving operational documentation, including runbooks, incident response procedures, reconciliation processes, checklists, and internal controls.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent judgment and a strong understanding of operational accountability, auditability, approval requirements, and escalation procedures.
  • Ability to work autonomously within established risk frameworks while recognizing when decisions require additional review or authorization.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical, financial, and business teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and adaptability, with the ability to balance recurring operational responsibilities with unexpected incidents and changing priorities.
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, digital assets, and capital markets.
  • Familiarity with AI agents and automation tools, including the ability to independently validate automated outputs and use AI responsibly to improve operational coverage.
  • Availability to work full-time within the Pacific Standard Time (PST, UTC-8) time zone, as required for this position.

    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage:

  • Previous experience in the cryptocurrency or blockchain industry, particularly with blockchain networks, cross-chain bridges, centralized exchanges, stablecoins, digital wallets, custody solutions, or cross-chain settlement.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and analytics platforms such as Grafana and Datadog.
  • Technical proficiency in SQL, Python, TypeScript, or similar programming and scripting languages.
  • Experience with financial reconciliation systems, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting tools.
  • Practical experience managing liquidity rebalances, treasury transfers, financial positions, P&L reporting, or risk limits.
  • Previous involvement in on-call rotations, incident management, provider escalations, or high-severity production support.
  • Demonstrated ability to transform manual operational processes into secure, monitored, and auditable automated workflows.
  • Experience collaborating with quantitative development and engineering teams to improve financial operations and system reliability.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary aligned with experience and qualifications.
  • Equity package, offering an opportunity to participate in the organization's long-term growth.
  • Comprehensive health benefits.
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO), with an encouraged minimum to support regular rest and work-life balance.
  • Fully remote-first working environment.
  • Flexible working culture that emphasizes collaboration, clear communication, and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to help establish and shape a newly created Liquidity Operations function.
  • High-ownership role with opportunities to contribute to operational strategy, automation, and technical improvements.
  • Exposure to innovative blockchain infrastructure, cryptocurrency markets, and cross-chain payment technologies.
  • Collaboration with experienced professionals across liquidity, quantitative development, and engineering.

As a Marketing Science Analyst, you will play a key role in monitoring, investigating and optimizing marketing mix models (MMM) used by hundreds of brands across major e-commerce and advertising platforms. Working within a data-driven environment, you will analyze production model alerts, identify anomalies and troubleshoot issues affecting the accuracy and reliability of marketing performance insights. You will combine statistical knowledge, analytical judgment and technical skills to distinguish data quality problems from modeling issues and recommend effective solutions. Using Python, SQL and AI-powered coding tools, you will investigate complex analytical workflows and improve model configurations. You will collaborate closely with Data Science and Customer Success teams, translating technical findings into practical business recommendations. This fully remote opportunity offers hands-on exposure to Bayesian modeling, marketing analytics and emerging AI-assisted technologies while contributing directly to the quality of insights used by global brands.

lists.content:
• Model monitoring and investigation: Monitor production marketing mix models and investigate alerts involving declining model fit, unusual Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) results and unexpected Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) fluctuations.
  • Develop investigation hypotheses, analyze relevant datasets, test potential causes and document findings, conclusions and recommendations.
  • Identify and distinguish modeling-related issues from data quality problems, including broken data feeds, incorrect campaign labels, reporting delays and other inconsistencies.
  • Prioritize investigations according to business impact, maintain accurate records and ensure issues are addressed within established timelines.
  • Marketing mix model optimization: Review and adjust production model configurations, including Bayesian priors, seasonality, holidays, promotions, trends and marketing channel classifications.
  • Evaluate modeling parameters such as adstock, Hill saturation and other statistical components when investigating performance anomalies.
  • Compare alternative model configurations against existing production models, assessing statistical fit, channel-level results and overall business plausibility.
  • Validate proposed configuration changes, promote approved adjustments and document rejected recommendations with supporting analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of model configurations, modifications, validation results and technical decisions.
  • AI-assisted data analysis: Use AI-powered coding agents, including Claude Code, to accelerate investigations, analyze model behavior and identify data discrepancies.
  • Review and interpret Python and SQL code to understand modeling pipelines, investigate analytical workflows and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Critically validate AI-generated analyses, calculations and recommendations against underlying datasets and statistical evidence.
  • Integrate AI-assisted workflows into daily analytical activities while maintaining accuracy, consistency and sound analytical judgment.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and documentation: Work closely with Data Science and Customer Success teams to communicate investigation results and coordinate issue resolution.
  • Translate complex statistical and modeling concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Track investigation queues, technical issues and resolution progress using Jira.
  • Maintain concise investigation reports, configuration change logs and technical documentation to facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing and effective handovers.
  • Performance and continuous improvement: Work toward defined operational objectives, including reviewing new model alerts and documenting initial hypotheses within one business day.
  • Aim to identify root causes and provide recommendations within three business days of an investigation.
  • Maintain a high level of investigation accuracy, targeting at least 90% correct classification of data-related versus model-related issues.
  • Ensure every approved or rejected configuration change is supported by documented comparisons of model fit and business plausibility.
  • Progress toward independently managing the complete model alert investigation process within the first 60 days.

    • Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, applied data science or a related analytical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating data discrepancies, performance anomalies and technical issues within analytical systems or data-driven environments.
  • Practical experience reading, interpreting and making minor modifications to Python code, alongside strong working knowledge of SQL.
  • Understanding of statistical modeling concepts, particularly Bayesian regression, marketing attribution, seasonality, adstock and saturation.
  • A degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical professional experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex modeling pipelines and identify potential sources of errors.
  • Sound analytical judgment when distinguishing data quality issues from modeling problems and evaluating the reliability of analytical outputs.
  • Experience using AI coding agents to support technical investigations, accelerate data analysis and validate analytical findings.
  • Ability to assess model configurations using both statistical performance indicators and business plausibility.
  • Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics, including channel-level ROAS and marketing effectiveness.

    • Nice to have:

  • Previous experience in marketing analytics or media buying, particularly when evaluating advertising channel performance and return on investment.
  • Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) or causal inference in an agency, technology vendor or in-house environment.
  • Familiarity with Bayesian marketing mix modeling methodologies and tools such as PyMC.
  • Experience analyzing e-commerce and advertising datasets from platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Ads, TikTok Shop, Meta and Google Ads.
  • Practical experience with Claude Code or other AI-powered coding and analytical tools.
  • Familiarity with AWS S3, AWS Athena, BigQuery, Hex and GitHub.
  • Experience using Jira for investigation tracking, project coordination and technical documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple investigations according to urgency and business impact.
  • Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and communicate technical findings clearly within a remote, cross-functional team.
  • Availability to work during US business hours, aligned with the client's time zone, from approximately 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: Monthly salary ranging from USD $2,000 to $2,400, depending on experience and geographical location.
  • Fully remote work: Work from home with the flexibility and convenience of a distributed working environment.
  • International collaboration: Work alongside experienced professionals in Data Science, Marketing Analytics and Customer Success.
  • Advanced technology exposure: Gain practical experience with AI coding agents, Bayesian modeling, Python, SQL and modern analytical platforms.
  • Professional development: Build specialized expertise in marketing mix modeling, causal inference and marketing performance measurement.
  • Meaningful business impact: Work directly with production models supporting hundreds of brands across leading e-commerce and advertising platforms.
  • Technical growth: Develop hands-on experience investigating complex analytical challenges and improving the reliability of customer-facing insights.
  • AI-driven environment: Contribute to innovative workflows that combine human analytical expertise with AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.

You will work across the entire machine learning lifecycle, from dataset preparation and model fine-tuning to evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. Your focus will be on adapting language models to evolving conversational scenarios, improving response quality, and ensuring reliable and efficient model performance. You will experiment with different models, prompting strategies, and inference technologies to balance accuracy, latency, and operational costs. Working closely with engineering and product teams, you will transform NLP research and experimentation into scalable, production-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to globally distributed digital products within an international, remote-first technology environment.

lists.content:
• Language Model Development: Train, fine-tune, and improve language models used in AI-powered conversational assistants and copilots. Adapt models to new conversation scenarios, response requirements, and structured output formats.
  • Dataset Preparation and Management: Build, prepare, and maintain high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Identify data gaps, analyze model errors, define annotation requirements, and review annotated examples to improve model performance.
  • Model Selection and Prompt Engineering: Evaluate and compare internally hosted language models with external model APIs, assessing response quality, latency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs.
  • Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements.
  • Model Deployment and API Development: Build, package, and maintain services and APIs around language models using FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications.
  • Inference Optimization: Improve model inference speed, GPU memory utilization, and serving costs while maintaining the required response quality and performance standards.
  • Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary.
  • Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences.
  • Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features.

    • Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks.
  • Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation.
  • Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA.
  • Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention.
  • Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance.
  • Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review.
  • Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches.
  • Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures.
  • Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes.
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data.
  • English proficiency sufficient to understand technical documentation, research papers, and communicate technical concepts.
  • Practical experience with recommendation systems, even at an introductory or project level.

lists.content:

  • Monitor daily campaign performance and adjust budgets, keyword bids, and bidding rules to maintain planned spending levels.

  • Maintain accurate daily performance trackers, ensuring advertising platform data is aligned with CRM information.

  • Perform weekly campaign maintenance, including placement reviews, disapproval checks, auction insights, and search query reports.

  • Execute assigned optimizations across keywords, audiences, Quality Scores, and targeting settings.

  • Set up, monitor, and evaluate campaign tests based on approved testing plans.

  • Prepare preliminary weekly and monthly performance analyses for review by the Paid Media Director.

  • Identify pacing risks, account issues, and performance anomalies, escalating them promptly when necessary.

  • Support weekly vendor meetings by preparing agendas, documenting discussions, and following up on action items.

  • Gradually take ownership of a broader range of monthly and quarterly optimization activities as experience develops.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing paid search and paid social campaigns, strong analytical abilities, and the discipline to maintain accurate campaign tracking and reporting.   • At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid search and paid social campaigns.

  • Experience independently managing monthly advertising budgets of at least $25,000, with $50,000 or more preferred.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

  • Established daily, weekly, and monthly routines for monitoring campaign pacing, tracking performance, and reviewing account settings.

  • Excellent attention to detail, with strong quality assurance and organizational habits.

  • Good analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign performance data and identify optimization opportunities.

  • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively through updates and meetings with a US-based Paid Media Director.

  • Ability to receive feedback, follow strategic direction, and progressively take on greater ownership.

  • A proactive and reliable approach to managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience in digital marketing for colleges, universities, educational institutions, training providers, or nonprofit organizations.

  • Background managing lead-generation campaigns focused on inquiries, applications, or student enrollments.

  • Familiarity with display, video, or streaming advertising campaigns.

  • Experience designing, launching, and evaluating A/B tests.

    • Benefits:

  • Compensation: Estimated monthly compensation of $2,000–$3,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Employment: Full-time contractor position, approximately 40 hours per week.

  • Remote Work: Fully remote opportunity open to professionals based in Latin America.

  • Paid Time Off: 20 paid days off annually, covering holidays, sick days, and regular vacation time.

  • Professional Development: Direct guidance and regular feedback from a Paid Media Director, with opportunities to develop skills and gradually assume greater responsibilities.

lists.content:

  • Paid Social Advertising

  • Assist in managing, launching, and optimizing paid social campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok, with potential expansion into Pinterest.

  • Monitor daily campaign performance, budgets, pacing, and key metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, and conversion rates.

  • Support campaign testing across audiences, creative assets, messaging, and advertising placements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, customer acquisition, and overall advertising efficiency.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Manager on paid media strategy, budget allocation, and campaign planning.

  • Help develop and execute advertising campaigns for product launches, promotions, and seasonal sales.

  • Analyze creative performance and recommend new advertising concepts, messaging approaches, and content ideas.

  • Prepare regular performance reports and communicate key findings, insights, and optimization recommendations.

  • Marketing Support

  • Assist the Brand Manager with day-to-day digital marketing projects and initiatives.

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to coordinate advertising assets and campaign deliverables.

  • Support campaign planning, promotional calendars, and new product launches.

  • Assist with email and SMS marketing activities, including campaign planning, scheduling, execution, and performance tracking.

  • Contribute to broader marketing initiatives that strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and sales performance.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has practical experience managing paid social campaigns, preferably within a direct-to-consumer (DTC) or e-commerce environment. You should combine analytical thinking with creative problem-solving, understand the dynamics of higher-priced products and longer purchase journeys, and be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a remote team.

  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience managing paid social advertising campaigns, ideally for a DTC or e-commerce brand.

  • Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and practical experience with TikTok Ads Manager.

  • Experience advertising high-average-order-value (AOV) products, preferably in home, lifestyle, or other considered-purchase categories.

  • Understanding of longer customer purchase journeys, retargeting strategies, and customer acquisition.

  • Ability to analyze campaign performance and make data-driven optimization decisions.

  • Familiarity with Shopify, Google Analytics, and advertising reporting tools.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proactive and resourceful mindset, with the initiative to identify opportunities and take ownership of tasks.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a small marketing team.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience managing Pinterest Ads campaigns.

  • Experience with creative testing, user-generated content (UGC), and influencer whitelisting or TikTok Spark Ads.

  • Familiarity with Klaviyo or other e-commerce marketing platforms.

  • Experience working with premium consumer brands.

  • Knowledge of customer acquisition strategies for products with longer consideration cycles.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly compensation ranging from $2,000 to $3,000 USD, depending on experience.

  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Latin America.

  • Flexible workload of 30–40 hours per week.

  • Direct collaboration with an experienced Brand Manager and marketing team.

  • Hands-on experience managing campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and potentially Pinterest.

  • Opportunity to develop expertise in paid media optimization, creative testing, and performance analysis.

  • Exposure to broader e-commerce marketing activities, including product launches, email, and SMS campaigns.

  • Opportunity to grow professionally alongside an expanding marketing team.

As a Paralegal, you will support a U.S.-based legal team specializing in immigration law, helping individuals, families, and investors navigate complex U.S. immigration procedures. Working closely with immigration attorneys, you will assist with preparing petitions, drafting legal documents, managing case files, and coordinating application submissions. Your role will be essential in ensuring that documentation is accurate, complete, and delivered within strict deadlines. You will also communicate directly with clients to collect supporting information, provide case updates, and facilitate smooth case progression. This fully remote opportunity offers hands-on exposure to U.S. immigration law across investor visas, family-based immigration, and nonimmigrant matters. It is an excellent opportunity for an organized and proactive legal professional looking to develop their expertise in an international legal environment.

lists.content:
Provide comprehensive legal and administrative support to immigration attorneys throughout the preparation and management of client cases. You will help ensure that petitions are properly documented, filing requirements are met, and case information remains accurate and accessible throughout the immigration process.

  • Prepare immigration petitions, government forms, and supporting documentation for E-2 and EB-5 investor visas, family-based immigration, and nonimmigrant visa applications.

  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, client correspondence, and other legal documents for attorney review.

  • Collect, organize, and review supporting evidence, ensuring that all required documents, forms, and signatures are accurate and complete.

  • Prepare and coordinate immigration filings in accordance with established procedures and submission deadlines.

  • Communicate with clients to request missing documents, provide case updates, and follow up on outstanding information.

  • Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date electronic case files using legal case management systems.

  • Monitor filing deadlines, government notices, and case statuses, promptly communicating relevant updates to attorneys.

  • Collaborate with attorneys to prioritize cases, coordinate documentation, and support daily legal operations.

  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential documentation issues early to prevent processing delays or filing rejections.

  • Manage multiple cases simultaneously while maintaining high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and organization.

    • Requirements:

    You are a detail-oriented and dependable legal support professional with strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. You communicate effectively in English, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are comfortable managing sensitive documentation and multiple deadlines. Previous exposure to U.S. immigration law is an advantage, but a strong foundation in paralegal or legal administrative work is essential.

  • At least 1 year of professional experience as a Paralegal, Legal Assistant, or in a similar legal support position.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing legal documents, government forms, and supporting evidence.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple cases and competing deadlines.

  • Advanced written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based attorneys and international clients.

  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and maintain productivity in a fully remote environment.

  • Strong communication and follow-up skills, with a proactive approach to collecting documentation and resolving outstanding requests.

  • High level of responsibility, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential client information.

  • Previous experience supporting U.S. immigration cases, particularly E-2, EB-5, family-based, or nonimmigrant visa petitions, is a strong advantage.

  • A Bachelor's degree is preferred.

  • Experience using electronic legal case management software is an advantage.

  • Bilingual proficiency is a plus.

  • Must be currently residing in Latin America.

  • Must be available to work full-time, Monday through Friday.

  • Ability to provide professional references during the final stages of the selection process, if requested.

  • A professional CV submitted in English is required.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% remote working arrangement from Brazil.

  • Full-time independent contractor opportunity.

  • Monday-to-Friday working schedule.

  • Opportunity to work directly with U.S.-based immigration attorneys.

  • Exposure to a variety of U.S. immigration matters, including investor visas, family-based petitions, and nonimmigrant applications.

  • Opportunity to develop specialized knowledge and professional experience in U.S. immigration law.

  • Collaborative international working environment.

  • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful legal cases supporting individuals, families, and investors.
