We are looking for an experienced sales professional to drive new customer acquisition and generate recurring revenue for a leading legal technology solution. In this role, you will manage the full consultative sales cycle, from understanding prospective clients’ operational challenges to demonstrating solutions, negotiating proposals, and closing deals. You will engage with multiple stakeholders, including end users, internal champions, and budget decision-makers, to build compelling business cases and move opportunities forward. Working closely with SDR, Marketing, Pre-Sales, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams, you will ensure a smooth customer journey from initial discovery through post-sale handover. This opportunity is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines strong negotiation skills, analytical thinking, and ownership of sales targets.

lists.content:
• Conduct in-depth sales discovery, building on information gathered by SDRs to understand clients’ current workflows, reasons for seeking a new system, and the business challenges behind their investment.

  • Map the purchasing process by identifying end users, internal project advocates, budget approvers, and all stakeholders involved in the decision.

  • Prepare and deliver consultative product demonstrations, selecting relevant workflows based on customer priorities and validating how the solution meets the needs of law firms and legal departments.

  • Develop and negotiate commercial proposals, defining scope, pricing, timelines, and terms within the authority of the role.

  • Coordinate with Product and Implementation teams to validate integration, data migration, or customization requirements before making commitments to customers.

  • Lead opportunities through closing by aligning approval steps, responsibilities, and deadlines, anticipating potential obstacles, and involving leadership when decisions exceed the role’s authority.

  • Manage the sales pipeline and maintain accurate forecasts in Pipedrive, including opportunity value, expected closing date, risks, and agreed next steps.

  • Explain forecast assumptions and changes during weekly pipeline reviews, using concrete progress and customer interactions to support projections.

  • Ensure a smooth post-sale handover to Implementation and Customer Success, communicating customer objectives, contracted scope, and commitments made during negotiations.

  • Share market insights with Marketing and Pre-Sales, including common objections, reasons for lost deals, and customer opportunity profiles.

  • Participate in events and relationship-building initiatives to generate conversations and develop new business opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SaaS sales and working toward Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) targets.

  • Experience managing complex sales negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, including direct engagement with purchasing decision-makers and budget approvers.

  • Ability to conduct consultative discovery, tailor product demonstrations, and build compelling investment cases that customers can present internally.

  • Experience using CRM platforms to prioritize opportunities, document next steps, and manage sales forecasts.

  • Strong active listening, clear communication, and negotiation skills.

  • Autonomy and accountability in managing commercial conditions, identifying risks, and coordinating with relevant internal teams.

  • Experience with sales involving software replacement, data migration, or system integration.

  • Familiarity with commercial CRM tools and participation in events within the legal or technology sectors.

  • Nice to have: Experience in SaaS companies or subscription-based business models.

  • Previous sales experience with legal departments, law firms, or corporate business units.

  • Familiarity with, or a strong interest in, the legal technology market and the daily operations of law firms and legal departments.

  • Experience using CRM and pipeline analysis tools to manage sales opportunities.

  • Interest in continuously improving consultative sales techniques and product knowledge.

  • Participation in industry events, trade shows, or business development initiatives.

    • Benefits:

  • Monthly food and meal allowance of R$1,300 through a flexible benefits card, with no payroll deduction.

  • Monthly home office allowance of R$135, with no payroll deduction.

  • National health insurance through Bradesco.

  • Dental insurance through SulAmérica.

  • Life insurance.

  • Extended parental leave, including support for adoption, same-sex couples, and single-parent families.

  • Childcare allowance for children up to 5 years old.

  • Wellhub (formerly Gympass) membership, providing access to gyms, studios, live classes, and wellness apps.

  • Conexa Saúde digital healthcare platform, including two free psychology consultations and two free nutrition consultations per month.

  • Guapeco pet health plan, with nationwide coverage and reimbursements of up to 100%.

  • Discounted language-learning partnerships for English and Spanish courses through OpenEnglish, Fluentia, and Instituto Cervantes.

  • Profit-sharing program (PLR), subject to the team achieving its annual target.

  • Relax Week: time off on business days between Christmas and New Year.

  • Home workstation allowance of R$2,400, in addition to a company-provided laptop.

  • Birthday day off during your birthday month.

  • Flexible remote working arrangement.

  • A development-focused environment offering feedback, individual development plans, onboarding support, learning communities, internal talks, performance reviews, and career development initiatives.

  • Practical experience with messaging and asynchronous communication technologies such as RabbitMQ and AWS SQS.
